target.title: fix(heartbeat): require explicit message targets on heartbeat runs
target.body:
Closes #103519

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users with heartbeat agents would receive leaked `HEARTBEAT_OK` text in their DM (routed agent) or hit `@heartbeat` / `chat not found` errors (isolated agent) when a heartbeat turn called the general `message` tool without an explicit recipient.

## Why This Change Was Made

Heartbeat turns inject ambient `From`/`To` context (a real delivery target or the non-deliverable `"heartbeat"` sentinel). Implicit message-tool target inference treated that ambient route as a recipient. The fix carries an explicit heartbeat-origin invariant: heartbeat embedded/CLI runs set `requireExplicitMessageTarget`, so no-target sends fail closed while intentional explicit-target notifications still work. Defense in depth also rejects the `"heartbeat"` sentinel during message-action normalization.

## User Impact

- Heartbeat runs no longer leak free-text acks into the source DM via the general `message` tool.
- Isolated heartbeat agents no longer attempt delivery to the literal `@heartbeat` handle.
- Explicit-target heartbeat notifications still work.
- Prefer `heartbeat_respond` for structured heartbeat acks (unchanged).

## Evidence

Verification host: local macOS (Crabbox bypass).

```text
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs \
    src/infra/outbound/message-action-normalization.test.ts \
    src/agents/tools/message-tool.test.ts \
    src/auto-reply/reply/agent-runner-execution.test.ts
# 21 + 120 + 239 tests passed

$ OPENCLAW_CHECK_CHANGED_REMOTE_CHILD=1 pnpm exec node scripts/check-changed.mjs -- \
    src/auto-reply/reply/agent-runner-execution.ts \
    src/infra/outbound/message-action-normalization.ts \
    src/infra/outbound/targets.ts \
    src/agents/tools/message-tool.ts
# typecheck core + core tests OK; lint 0 errors; import-cycle 0
```

Focused behavior cases:

```text
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/infra/outbound/message-action-normalization.test.ts -t "heartbeat"
# 3 passed (sentinel not injected; real ambient route still infers)

$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/tools/message-tool.test.ts -t "heartbeat-style|allows explicit-target send"
# no-target send with requireExplicitTarget throws; explicit target allowed

$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/auto-reply/reply/agent-runner-execution.test.ts -t "requires explicit message targets on heartbeat"
# heartbeat embedded run passes requireExplicitMessageTarget: true
```

## Real behavior proof

- Behavior addressed: Heartbeat no-recipient `message` sends no longer use ambient delivery target / `"heartbeat"` sentinel as an implicit recipient.
- Environment: local macOS openclaw checkout; focused Vitest + local `check:changed` child.
- Current-main contrast: On main, heartbeat runs leave `requireExplicitMessageTarget` unset; `normalizeMessageActionInput` injects `toolContext.currentChannelId` (real DM or `"heartbeat"`) as `target` for no-recipient sends.
- Exact steps or command run after this patch:
  1. `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/auto-reply/reply/agent-runner-execution.test.ts -t "requires explicit message targets on heartbeat"`
  2. `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/tools/message-tool.test.ts -t "heartbeat-style"`
  3. `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/infra/outbound/message-action-normalization.test.ts -t "heartbeat"`
- Evidence after fix: All three pass. Heartbeat embedded run params include `requireExplicitMessageTarget: true`. Message tool with that flag rejects no-target `send` of `HEARTBEAT_OK` without calling the action runner. Normalization refuses `"heartbeat"` as inferred target and still infers real ambient routes for normal (non-heartbeat) turns.
- Control check: Ordinary embedded runs omit `requireExplicitMessageTarget` (subagent default path preserved). Explicit `target` still succeeds under `requireExplicitTarget`. Real ambient channel ids still infer for non-heartbeat tool context.
- Observed result after fix: Heartbeat-origin no-recipient message sends fail closed with an explicit-target requirement instead of delivering to ambient DM / `@heartbeat`.
- What was not tested: Live Telegram heartbeat round-trip in a real workspace (CS acceptance criteria for this issue are unit/source-level; open PR #103660 is a weaker sentinel-only approach and was not used as base).

## AI disclosure

This fix was authored with AI assistance (Grok). Proof commands and results above were run on the local machine.
